title: Mark 7:5 — Pharisees ask about eating with impure hands
summary: Mark 7:5 in English, with the Pharisees and scribes asking why Jesus' disciples eat bread with impure hands instead of keeping the tradition of the elders. Below the verse is a photo of a beige two-handled hand-washing cup beside a bathroom sink.

text.text: 5 The Pharisees and the scribes asked Him, “Why do Your disciples not walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with impure hands?”

pictures.description: Close-up photo of a beige plastic two-handled hand-washing cup (a netilat yadayim cup) with a pouring lip, sitting on a white bathroom shelf beside a mirror, with a beige marble-tiled wall behind it and a small tassel or cord hanging above.
